pages.title: Mage Flame
pages.text: $(o)The weakest of the summoned flames, well-suited for the apprentice spellcaster. It will allow you to see, but not as bright as a regular torch. It is not strong enough to navigate through vines and other replaceable blocks, and will extinguish if it is unable to follow its owner.

pages.title: Mage Flame Recipe
pages.text: Allows the spellcaster to create a small ball of flames.$(br)Brightness = 9$(br)Duration = 10 minutes
